notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Released
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Quick little update to fix some confusion in the game, as well as fix some other bugs and issues. Here's what's new:
[list]
[*]Combined the zoom and alt. fire buttons into a single button.
[*]The alt. fire button, rather than the power shot button, is now used to refund towers.
[*]Changed the default power shot binding from mouse2 to Q.
[*]Added a default alt. fire binding on mouse2.
[*]The W and S keys can now be used to scroll through the shop/codex items.
[*]Fixed an issue with scaled desktop resolutions causing the game to not find a video mode that matches the desktop resolution. This caused the game to often times be in a very small window (the lowest possible resolution) and not take up the entire screen.
[*]Enemies will no longer travel between a tower base and a pre-placed tower.
[*]Added a notification the first time you overheat a weapon.
[*]Added a notification the first time you place an upgradeable tower.
[*]Added some notifications for special situations - like flying enemies and slopes.
[*]If a consumable item cannot currently be used (ex. a food item when you have full health), the button to press use it is no longer displayed, and the icon is no longer highlighted.
[*]Fixed some awkwardness with Vance's camera sometimes being inside a tower when playing his cleared animation.
[*]Fixed the Energy Conduit (tower kills give meter) allowing the player to power shot without power shots being unlocked.
[*]Removed one of the steps in the second tutorial to reduce confusion.
[*]Removed the Discord/mailing list buttons from the title screen.[/list]
Thanks everyone! See you in the Exoverse.

notes.title: Beta Branch Update #12
notes.content:
Hey there!

We've got another big update on the beta branch. Things are shaping up nicely! This time we've got some big character changes to Kain and Fabian, some big optimizations, a new weapon, and more!

We're looking to wrap things up here pretty soon. Stay tuned!

Here's what's new:
[list][*]Updated the Bravestar's attack so you damage enemies much earlier in the swing. Additionally, there are a couple of different swing animations that it alternates between.
[*]Kain can now deflect missiles using the Bravestar's alternate fire! It has a dedicated animation, and is way less clunky than doing it with your attack.
[*]Fabian's kill streak timer now pauses when stealthed.
[*]Completed textures for Starlyn's arms.
[*]Completed the Magnetar! It's a very powerful alien railgun that can be charged up to gain various properties.
[*]Added a new alternate fire key that can be bound in the menu. This alternate fire currently allows you to parry with the Bravestar.
[*]Added symbol icons underneath your crosshair target's health bar. These show status effects present on the target, and special properties (like invulnerable).
[*]Invulnerable objects now have an icon on their health bar, instead of their health bar displaying in a different color.
[*]Made several optimizations in various areas. The game should be running better now.
[*]Updated the particles for armored and shredded enemies.
[*]Lowered the health cost of the double shield generator from 2 hearts to 1.5.
[*]Raised the price on the oxygen canister from $250 to $1,000.
[*]Updated the bazooka reload so it's a bit longer.
[*]Updated the revolver sprint animation.
[*]Updated the unlock description for craftable items from "Collect Relics to Unlock" to "Craft with Relics in Crafting Shop".
[*]All enemies are now overkilled upon killing the boss (instead of walking around during your victory animation).
[*]Fixed stealthed enemies sometimes having an improper outline thickness.
[*]Fixed the screen shaking while the game is paused after firing a weapon.
[*]Fixed the render of transparent textures on stealthed objects.
[*]Fixed taking damage from non-damaging sources (like the end of the Gravitar's power shot, which applies a slow).
[*]Fixed a load screen issue when continuing on certain levels.
[*]Fixed the Y offset of third person animations during the area cleared sequence. This properly puts Fabian on the ground.
[*]Made a fix so that the plants/trees on the Rainforest are now saved and restored properly when continuing.
[*]Fixed some issues with the red portion of the health bar that ticks down after damaging an enemy.
[*]Fixed Kain slowing enemies inside of portals.
[*]Removed the Mechanical Arm from the upgrade shop. Doesn't look like it's going to be a winner. Oh well![/list]
Thanks everyone! See you in the Exoverse!

notes.title: Beta Branch Update #11
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Big ol' update this time in the beta branch! We're a major step closer to completion as Fabian joins the fray! Plus, we've got a bunch of new items, optimizations, and more!

Here's what's new:
[list][*]Fabian is now playable! \o/ All of his perks are in, as well as his arms, textures, and third person animations. He's only missing his weapon, so for now... have a Blazar!
[*]Changed Fabian's 2nd perk to deal bonus damage (25%) to disabled targets.
[*]New artifact: Blast Guard! This protects you from splash damage (which can get pretty crazy with upgrades).
[*]New artifact: Dry Ice! This helps your turrets (and weapons!) recover from being overheated much more quickly.
[*]New artifact: Thermal Detonator! This causes your turrets to burn everything in their range when they overheat.
[*]New consumable: Mini Nuke! This summons a nuke in front of you that drops onto your enemies.
[*]Barricades now produce visual effects when damaged and need repairs. This effect intensifies as the barricade becomes more damaged.
[*]Destroyed barricades now produce holograms when going back to the planning phase. This easily shows you where a barricade is missing and can be replaced.
[*]Made several performance increases. The game should be running quite a bit better now - especially with loads of decals!
[*]Shadows can now be applied to transparent level surfaces.
[*]Improved the rendering of stealthed objects.
[*]Enemies now regain stealth after 2 seconds (was 1).
[*]Fixed a crash sometimes occurring when shooting a kamikaze with a piercing weapon.
[*]Fixed certain effects (like fields) affecting enemies inside portals.[/list]
Thanks everyone! We'll see you in the Exoverse!

We're back once again with a beta branch update. We've been focusing a lot on getting the world 2 settings up to par, and we're another big step closer.

[*]The "Quit Game/Quit to Title" options on the pause menu are now updated to indicate whether or not your game will be saved when using these options.

notes.title: Beta Branch Update #8
notes.content:
Hey there!

Quick little update to the beta branch here to introduce some new content (gimlet turrets!). These past couple updates also address one of the big issues with the game from day 1, which is the way the range and speed stats work.

Here's what's new:
[list]
[*]Hooked up gimlet turrets! They're good to go now. Each level of turret ignores a particular aspect of enemy defense (shells, armor, etc.). Available in world 3.
[*]Weapons now fire an [b]infinite[/b] distance.
[*]Range now affects only the effective range of the weapon - where it does the most damage possible.
[*]Made tweaks to the crosshair color to better show when you're at the maximum effective range, and the minimum effective range.
[*]Increased the base player movement speed from 2.0 to 2.5.
[*]New item: the Rune of Tucana! This common rune heals you when your kill streak reaches a multiple of 16 (16, 32, 48, 64, etc.).
[*]Renamed the "Unlock" shop to the "Crafting" shop.
[*]Changed the slowed effect (and text!) from gray to violet.
[*]The weapons, rune, and consumable shops now only show those types of existing items in your inventory at the lower left corner.
[*]Added to the kamikaze and doomwalker descriptions to indicate that they explode when overkilled.
[*]Fixed items being unlockable in The Lab.
[*]Fixed objects not appearing in the proper location on the tab screen map.
[*]Sales in the unlock shop are now displayed the same as they are in the items shop.[/list]
We hope you're happy with the way range and speed work after these past couple updates. I know we are!

Thanks everyone!

Here's what's new:

[list][*]Finished animation work on the rare rifle - the stinger! It's all good now!

notes.title: Beta Branch Update #6
notes.content:
Hey there!

We're back with another great update to the beta branch! This one adds a great deal of polish, as well as some clarity improvements and gameplay updates to marks.

Here's what's new:
[list]
[*]Added a new and complete game over screen! It's much nicer than before, and fits the game's art style far better.
[*]Added a new speed lines effect that replaces the screen blurring when using the turbosphere. This applies to Starlyn's speed boost perk as well.
[*]Giggordo's totems now have VFX indicating their effect on Giggordo.
[*]New VFX for the Gravitar's rocket explosion.
[*]Improved the visuals of the store interiors.
[*]Removed redundancy and increased clarity on many of the tower tooltips.
[*]Turrets now properly attack monsters that have their stealth broken from taking damage or attacking.
[*]Turrets will now attack stealth enemies that are marked.
[*]Fixed a bug preventing headshots on shielded enemies when having a shield piercing item.
[*]Started hooking up the new stinger animations.
[*]Increased the damage towers do to marked targets.
[*]Increased the item despawn time on hard from 16 to 24 seconds.
[*]Reduced the marked status duration from 12 seconds to 10.
[*]Reduced the number of enemies marking fields affect slightly.
[*]Increased the combat reward for overkills and multikills on worlds 2 and 3.
[*]Tweaked Dark Matter - it now upgrades kills. Normal kills become overkills (like before), and overkills will become hyperkills.

notes.content:

As you may know, the previous update was our last one before our full release. We're gearing up towards that full release, and are hard at work getting the new content finished up for it, as well as some fixes and optimizations to existing features and content. - An alternate world 1 setting (the Disposal Area) - available once you beat the Metroplex

- A modeled and textured Orbital Station
- The fourth and final world
- Three additional weapons
- A new difficulty called "custom" that allows you to fully configure your difficulty experience... from mega easy to mega hard!
- A fifth shop, allowing you to trade health for body upgrades
- Lots of new items

- Massive performance improvements

- The mostly finished Disposal Area

notes.title: BIG Update #15 "Into the Exoverse" Released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32019344/61437d175f92c4bda201fe74b0af04bbae684c81.png[/img]

We're back with our biggest update yet! Last update was all about putting a nice little bow on the content we had... and this one is the total opposite! It adds a [i]ton[/i] of fun, new content without being hamstrung.

This will also be our [i]final[/i] update before the [b]full release[/b]. We're not exactly sure when that will happen, but expect a trailer to drop in the near future with a release date.

On to the patch notes!

[b]WORLD 3[/b]
[list][*]Go deeper into the Exoverse with world 3 - the Orbital Station! Currently a graybox, but at least it has nice concept art!
[*]Added the tympitt! These are shelled creatures that can wreak all sorts of havoc on your maze.
[*]Added the oboar! These disgusting creatures eat corpses of their fallen allies to evolve into... even more disgusting creatures!
[*]Added the saxxarac! These are stealthed enemies that sneak by your turrets undetected... unless you break their stealth by attacking them!
[*]Added the kagorox overlord! This eldritch-esque abomination bestows nearby enemies with the gifts of stealth... or invulnerability! Kill them!
[*]Added the tubaki predator/reaper! Would like to do more to differentiate these from the hunter.[/list]
[b]MINIBOSSES[/b]
[list][*]Added minibosses! These can spawn once during the final wave. Each species has its own miniboss.
[/list]
[b]NEW ARTIFACTS[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Napalm Bullets! These cause your power shot bullets to explode causing burn.
[*]Added Orbiting Grenades! These circle the player and explode when they make contact with an enemy.
[*]Added the Cybernetic Leg! This enhances your sprinting by increasing sprint speed by 50%, and granting the ability to sidestep while sprinting.
[*]Added the Bionic Lens! These enhances your headshots by increasing headshot damage by 25%, and granting the ability for headshots to ignore armor and penetrate thick skin (allowing you to headshot cymaran).
[*]Added the Cyber Monocle! This reveals those pesky stealthed enemies in world 3.
[*]Added the Triplex Capacitor! This gives you the ability to do *three* power shots upon filling your meter.
[*]Added the Complex Capacitor! This allows you to charge your power shot all the way up to level 3.
[*]Added the Neosteel Shells! This causes your slot 4 weapons to always fire their power shot missile (as opposed to the regular one).
[*]Added the Power Coupling! Firing a power shot will cause it to be fired from *all* of your turrets as well.
[*]Added the Antimatter Bullets! These cause your bullets to explode on contact.
[*]Added the Magnetic Gloves! These will pull nearby pickups towards you.[/list]
[b]NEW RUNES[/b]
[list][*]Added the Rune of Monoceros! This increases the relic drop rate by 100%.[/list]
[b]NEW CONSUMABLES[/b]
[list][*]Added the Extinguisher! Cools all towers (and the Blazar!) when used.
[/list][b]NEW PICKUPS[/b]
[list][*]Added Ammunition! This pickup reloads your current weapon.
[*]Added the Quantium Battery! This increases your power shot meter by 3 (allowing your bar to fill completely with a complex capacitor).
[*]Added the Coin Purse! It's worth $1,000. Adjusted the other gold pickups accordingly.[/list]
[b]NEW BOSS[/b]
[list][*]Added Bullero! He's an alien bull who will charge you when provoked. Oh, and that charge can destroy towers, by the way.[/list]
[b]NEW & IMPROVED[/b]
[list][*]Removed much of the XP-related progression. Champions, shops, inventory slots, etc. are now fully available from the start. Now, only power shots and the characters are unlocked through XP.
[*]The thumper now fires a freezing grenade on the last round of the magazine, instead of a 20% freeze chance for any grenade fired.
[*]Added a transition for going to/coming from top-down building mode.
[*]Fixed several issues with top-down building mode.
[*]The right mouse button can now be used to exit menus, shops, and the tab screen.
[*]Items now despawn more slowly on hard, and much more slowly on easy/normal.
[*]Reworked the unlocks menu. It now displays all of the icons all at once, instead of only 4 and making you scroll. This gives you a much better overview of what items there are and what's still locked.
[*]Tubaki now spawn like regular enemies and no longer require unlocking. They also have upcoming icons like regular enemies.
[*]Towers can now absorb phaseeker missiles - not just the Beacon.
[*]Heavily buffed amp fields so they have a much higher damage dealt/taken multiplier.
[*]Amp fields no longer go on cooldown until everything has exited the field for two full seconds.
[*]Reduced bonus enemy damage to towers/Beacon from 100% to 50% on hard.
[*]Increased the range on pistols from 192.0 to 256.0.
[*]Increased the range on shotguns from 192.0 to 256.0.
[*]Increased the range on the bazooka and Gravitar from 320.0 to 384.0.
[*]Increased the damage on the pistol from 30.0 to 35.0.
[*]Increased the damage on the revolver from 80.0 to 90.0.
[*]Updated numerous descriptions for the sake of clarity.
[*]Updated several enemy icons.
[*]Tower bases now take a few kicks from cymaran before being destroyed.
[*]Increased the spawn chance of artifacts during waves 2 and 4.
[*]The oxygen canister now causes explosions to apply a burn.
[*]The chlorine canister now causes large explosions to apply poison.
[*]Reduced the health on Giggordo's totems by 25%.
[*]Giggordo no longer instantly breaks tower bases with his girthquake. They can now withstand multiple hits before being destroyed.
[*]Giggordo no longer fires his empowered missiles (the ones that persist after exploding) normally. He now only fires them when his power totems are up.
[*]Added one additional cluster to the final wave of each level (in addition to the miniboss).
[*]The current/par tower expenditure is now displayed next to the icon.
[*]Doomwalker/Clawface explosion VFX now happen from the bomb location (instead of the spine).
[*]Updated color on the phaseekers.
[*]Power shot rockets now produce a large scorch decal (instead of a normal-sized one).
[*]Renamed the Blazar's power shot from "Blazing Strike" to "Blaze of Glory". It's the perfect name and should have been called this from the start.
[*]Improved the Uranus fun fact. Yes, I'm including this in the patch notes.
[/list][b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the missing knife texture on the snaar trooper.
[*]Reduced memory usage in the Nebula Omnis.[/list]
Thanks everyone! We'll see you for our full release soon!

[b]WEAPON REWORKS[/b][list]
[*]Reworked the Blitzar! Its pellets now have a chance to create a small explosion, and overkills create a normal-sized explosion. Pellets no longer ricochet.

[*]Overkills now restore energy with the Blitzar.
[*]Headshots now restore energy with the Pulsar.
[*]Multikills now restore energy with the Gravitar.
[*]Completed the thumper's power shot, Cryoblast, along with its effects.
[*]Updated the shotgun's power shot. It's now called "Crowd Control", and stuns any enemy it hits for 4 seconds.
[*]Made slight tweaks to the shredder's power shot. It functions mostly the same, but is no longer an area effect.
[*]Increased the Gravitar's damage, and gave it custom rockets with custom effects.[/list]
[b]NEW & IMPROVED[/b][list]
[*]Added a new difficulty setting - easy! This has many of the recent difficulty changes (cheaper towers, bonus stats), and normal is now more like it used to be.
[*]Normal now has 20% more monsters than easy.
[*]Added a significant amount of props and polish to the Nebula Omnis.
[*]Added a completed credits sequence.
[*]Snaar now become aggressive towards you if you damage them.
[*]Commandos will now destroy any nearby turrets (and their tower base!) when damaged by towers.
[*]Sped up xylander's walk speed by about 10%.
[*]Added a "Overheat!" HUD message when a turret overheats.
[*]Added a "Low Ammo!" HUD message when firing a shot causes you to be low on ammo.
[*]Renamed combos to multikills.
[*]Renamed power combos to powerkills.
[*]Killing a single enemy with a power shot now grants a powerkill (along with a small bonus).
[*]The tutorial now has its own difficulty setting, and no longer changes your existing setting.
[*]Made some changes to reduce the amount of memory used by the game.
[*]The shield charger is now locked by default, and unlocks once you gain a shield.
[*]Your kill streak graphic now has a different display when frozen.
[*]Added a frame around the weapon/tower icons on the UI.
[*]Added a frame behind your current rune.
[*]Updated the tooltip frame.
[*]Added a display about how to give weapons/towers when in the lab.
[*]Replaced the unanimated shopkeepers with animated ones.
[*]The portals now pause when the game pauses.
[*]Added a new popup the first time a barricade is destroyed saying it can be repaired.
[*]The same stinger is now used for all bosses.
[*]Reduced the number of enemies on the Rainforest.
[*]Power shots are no longer shown on weapon tooltips until they're unlocked.
[*]Land mines now apply the intended amount of stun.
[*]Raised shred duration from 4 seconds to 6.
[*]Raised mark duration from 8 seconds to 12.
[*]The crosshair now transitions more seamlessly between blue (suboptimal range) and red (optimal range).
[*]Improved the rendering of holograms.
[*]Non-fleshy things (like barricades and totems) no longer bleed when shot.
[*]Barricade destruction now has much better visual effects - including leaving behind oil decals.
[*]Increased the marked damage multiplier on all towers.
[*]Increased the shotgun's damage against stunned targets from +75% to +125%.
[*]Added various grunge decals to the Metroplex.[/list]
[b]FIXES[/b][list]
[*]Fixed a crash occurring after a land mine lands an overkill.
[*]Fixed a bug causing enemies to sometimes leave the trail unintentionally on the Rainforest.
[*]Fixed a bug preventing towers from firing after loading a game.
[*]Fixed a mouseover error on the area result screen.
[*]Fixed some misaligned tooltips on the item screen when at non-1080p resolutions.
[*]Fixed a bug allowing you to block Space Jam's path.
[*]Fixed a small memory leak between levels.
[*]Fixed an issue where kamikazes and doomwalkers would still be present in the world for a short time after exploding (despite being invisible).
[*]Fixed a bug causing power shot trail animations to sometimes play improperly.[/list]
Thanks everyone! See you out there in the Exoverse.

notes.title: Update #13 "Mazes and Menus" Released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32019344/4d12b1d2693b37a56638f4d235fe76883467d8aa.png[/img]

Hey there!

With this update, we shed even more of our Early Access skin. We've added a sexy new main menu (the old one was a placeholder), and several other big improvements to the game's interface. We've also made big changes to the core gameplay by increasing the number of enemies on hard, encouraging... [i]*gasp*[/i] tower defense!

Here's what's new:

[b]INTERFACE[/b][list]
[*]Added a brand new main menu! This one matches the Exoverse theme, and fully animates.
[*]Added a new par tower expenditure icon to the HUD during planning phases. This icon lets you know when you've gone over budget (if you care!).
[*]You can now mouseover the portals on the tab screen map to see upcoming enemies.
[*]You can now mouseover your inventory in the lower left corner when in shops.
[*]More tooltips are now available for all result screens.
[*]Added an animation for changing between tab screens and shops.[/list]
[b]CORE GAMEPLAY[/b][list]
[*]Increased the number of enemies on hard by 50%. Build some bigger mazes!
[*]Your kill streak window is now slightly more laxed until reaching cosmic (23+).
[*]Your kill streak timer now pauses until your power shot animation finishes (rather than ending once it fires). This gives you more time to get a reload off after your power shot to keep your streak going.
[*]End of area rewards are now very similar to end of round rewards. You're rewarded for not taking damage, protecting the Beacon, not going over budget, etc. Additional multipliers are given for meeting the par in *all* rounds.[/list]
[b]ADDITIONS & IMPROVEMENTS[/b][list]
[*]Added new animations for the Pulsar! Still needs gameplay tweaks, but it's looking great now, and uses the right set of arms for all characters.
[*]Movement keys can now be used during top-down mode to move the camera.
[*]The camera and player position are now tied together in top-down mode.
[*]When highlighting a tower base, the health bars of neighboring barricades are now shown too (for the sake of repairs).
[*]Minor fixes and improvements to the first tutorial.
[*]The first tutorial now spawns much sexier weapons.
[*]Enemies that haven't been defeated yet now have a "???" icon in portals.
[*]Added various sounds to the tab screen and shops for things like highlights and screen changes.
[*]Increased the budget on Metroplex I.[/list]
[b]FIXES[/b][list]
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented anything from displaying when in windowed mode at a resolution equal to the desktop resolution.
[*]Fixed some minor slowdown when picking up certain weapons for the first time.
[*]Fixed some walking/sprinting sounds during top-down mode.
[*]Profile progress is now saved as soon as it's made.[/list]
Thanks everyone! We'll see you out there in the Exoverse!

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32019344/79bf253b9f18648b496511a71940a31e9665325f.png[/img]

Hey there!

[*]Added an enemy codex to the tab screen! This now shows detailed information about each enemy, including health, Beacon DPS, and special properties.
[*]Enemy codex entries are unlocked upon killing enemies for the first time.
[/list]
[b]TOP-DOWN BUILDING[/b][list]
[*]Added a new top-down building mode! This allows you to place towers much more quickly, and with greater clarity.
[*]Added a new "build mode" button to the control settings menu. The default is mouse3.
[*]The top-down view can be scrolled by moving your cursor to the edge of the screen.
[/list]

[*]The functionality of the automap, compass, and radar are now baseline.

[*]Dramatically improved the randomness of boss selections, item spawns, weapon effects, and more!

[*]Removed certain player-specific graphics from the pre-cache graphics pool.
[*]Various minor optimizations.
[*]Increased ranger health from 60.0 to 70.0.
[*]Updated Starlyn's unlock graphic to match her new character description.
[*]Improved Rainforest skybox color.
[*]Reverted player shapes to capsules.
[/list]

[*]Fixed some level generation issues on the Rainforest.
[*]Fixed the skybox not being factored into reflections on certain weapons/objects.
[*]Fixed a stretching issue on the background of the result screen when at non-1080p resolutions.
[*]Turrets dealing area damage (such as pulse) no longer deal extra damage to enemies overlapping more than one tile.
[*]Fixed a range display issue when multiple turrets overlap the same tile.
[*]Made a fix to prevent scattershot turret tile ranges from stacking on top of each other.
[*]Fixed an issue causing tiles to be mistakenly grayed out on the auto map/tab screen map.
[*]Fixed some muddiness with the crosshairs.
[*]Fixed the Rune of Chameleon applying an effect to the tower generator when entering a new area.
[/list]
Thanks everyone! We'll see you out there in the Exoverse!

Hey there!

We're back [i]one week early[/i] with another update! We have a lot of changes aimed at making the game a lot more fun and less stressful to play, and didn't want to sit on those changes for another week. We'll try to keep these quicker updates going with the next one schedules for two weeks from today!

Here's the full list of changes:

[b]STARLYN[/b][list]
[*]Added a new playable character: Starlyn! She's the intrepid ranged collector. More coming soon (including her arms!).
[*]Added Starlyn's weapon: the Thundergun! This is an electricity-based weapon that you change up before firing. Be sure to read its tooltip, and try it out in the lab![/list]

[*]The Beacon now zaps enemies trying to attack it. It's capable of dealing with some groups of enemies all by itself.
[*]Lowered the health/shields on all monsters by roughly 20%, and increased the number of monsters by roughly 10%.
[*]The Beacon is now invulnerable during all tutorials.
[*]Towers are now 50% off on normal mode.
[*]Unlocking an item in the unlock shop now gives you the item as well.
[*]Unlocking items for the first time now creates an explanation popup.[/list]

[*]Giggordo no longer does double the normal amount of damage for the given world.

[*]Changed up random number generation. This should lead to better randomization of boss selection, items spawning, etc.
[*]Updated the normal mode description.
[*]Improved the chieftain animations.
[*]Slightly slowed down the "Cleared!" display after clearing an area.
[*]Buyback items in the shop no longer have their price listed (since they don't cost anything).

[*]Increased the marked multiplier of level 3 machinegun turrets from 150% to 300%.
[*]Increased the number of enemies level 1 marking fields mark before going on cooldown from 2 to 3.

[*]Increased the number of enemies level 3 marking fields mark before going on cooldown from 8 to 20.[/list]

[*]Fixed some display issues on the tab screen when using non 16:9 aspect ratio resolutions.
[*]Fixed a bug allowing the training dummy to be removed from the lab.
[*]Changed various descriptions to make it clearer that certain items heal you.
[*]Games are no longer saved in the lab.

Thanks everyone! We'll see you out there in the Exoverse!

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32019344/e6f9e7d3ad2eb318bd1173697f209a90f7fdeb0d.png[/img]

Hey there!

We're back with another update! This one really seeks to make the game more understandable. With a new tutorial, an area where you can experiment, and new features like a grid display, we hope everyone can sail through the Exoverse confusion free!

Here's the full list of changes:

[b]THE LAB[/b][list]
[*]Added the lab! This is an area where you can test out your weapons, maze designs, and a whole lot more!
[*]Added a new training dummy enemy. This has been added to the lab, as well as the second tutorial.[/list]
[b]QUALITY OF LIFE[/b][list]
[*]A grid is now displayed on the world during the planning phase. Tiles you cannot place anything on (such as in front of the Beacon) are now displayed in red.
[*]Trail indicators now appear on the automap.
[*]Portals that spawn multiple strengths of enemies now produce multiple trails.
[*]Enemies now spawn closer to the portal exit. This makes waves of enemies reach the world faster.
[*]Added more specific messages to explain why towers cannot be placed.
[*]The player is now rendered on the tab screen map, as well as objects/enemies if the player has the radar.
[*]Tiles you cannot place anything on now appear as dark gray blocks on the automap/tab screen map.
[*]Temporary towers now have a transparent display on the automap/tab screen map.
[*]Added an explanation popup the first time a turret overheats.[/list]
[b]BLAZAR REWORK[/b][list]
[*]Increased the base damage from 40 to 45.
[*]Increased the bonus damage against burning enemies from 50% to 100%.

[*]Doomwalkers now fully play their explosion sound - instead of stopping once they blow apart.

[*]The medal displayed after you beat a boss is now a reflection of your performance at the boss.

[*]Fixed monsters not responding properly to destroyed barricades.

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32019344/f5468aae0a29d302141bc72c3d92701209da8f96.png[/img]

Hey there!

We're back with another BIG update! This update completes the tower family by adding the 4th and final type of tower... mines! Not only that, but this update adds a more complete tubaki hunter, a new result screen, more combat improvements, much needed fixes, and more!

Here's the full list of changes:

[b]TUBAKI HUNTERS[/b][list]
[*]The tubaki hunter is now fully textured and animated!
[*]Hunters now cling to the wall briefly after you dodge their attack.
[*]Tubaki now print a "Warning!" message when exiting the portal.[/list]
[b]MINES[/b][list]
[*]Added the 4th type of tower: Mines! When stepped on by enemies, mines explode causing all sorts of havoc.
[*]Added land mines, which explode and damage all nearby enemies.
[*]Added gas mines, which explode and create a poison cloud lasting several seconds poisoning all enemies that walk through.
[*]Added flashbang mines, which explode and stun all nearby enemies for several seconds.
[*]Added sticky mines, which explode and slow all nearby enemies.
[*]Mines are now available in the tower shop once they're unlocked (XP level 20).[/list]
[b]COMBAT IMPROVEMENTS[/b][list]
[*]Pistols can now be fired more rapidly by re-pressing the fire button, rather than just holding it down.
[*]Snaar can now be mini-stunned if you deal enough damage to them during their yell.
[*]Rangers no longer all counterattack at the exact same time.
[*]Xylanders will now counter attack only if the player kills another of the same exact breed (ex. rangers counterattack if a ranger dies, vagabonds counterattack if a vagabond dies, etc.).[/list]
[b]NEW & IMPROVED[/b][list]
[*]Added a brand new result screen! This is used between rounds, at the end of an area, and after defeating a boss.
[*]Your reward between rounds is now based on more factors, and is different depending on the area you're playing in.
[*]Overkills now increase the drop chance of a relic by 25%.
[*]Each playable character now has their own conversations with the shop keeps - rather than always being between Kain and the shop keep.
[*]Level 2/3 gravity fields are now more powerful.
[*]Added VFX and a slight screen shake for the doomwalker's footsteps.
[*]Added a screen shake to most explosions.
[*]Added descriptions for all fields.
[*]Added some missing transition sounds.
[*]Remade the Anime Ace font and made several string tweaks.
[*]Pressing enter during the third person animation now advances it to the end for the area cleared display.[/list]
[b]FIXES[/b][list]
[*]Enemies will now avoid walking over slopes on the Rainforest unless given no other choice. Flying enemies (and striders!) ignore this rule.
[*]Fixed some world generation issues with the Rainforest.
[*]Power shot damage that doesn't come from the bullet directly (ex. explosions) can now cause a power shot finish at bosses.
[*]The automap is now affected by fades that affect the HUD.
[*]Fixed animation events not occurring at the right times on animations with a randomized start time.
[*]Fixed being able to save your game during the victory sequence.
[*]Fixed a bug that was making fields not properly switch between activated/waiting for something to step in.
[*]Marking fields now only activate when a monster walks in.
[*]Fixed a bug causing level lights to not spawn in portals in the Metroplex.
[*]Fixed the rules for placing towers. Mines and fields can be placed in the same node, but not in nodes with bases.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused you to be a character other than the one you played as after exiting to a new level after restoring a save.[/list]

Thanks everyone! We'll see you out there in the Exoverse.

Hey everyone!

We're once again continuing to make a great deal of progress! This update makes improvements to the combat system, the relic system, and even allows you to take a break and pick right back up where you left off!

[*]The portal certain enemies come from is now more consistent between planning phases.
[*]Replaced the "Wave Complete!" graphic with a "Round Complete!" graphic at the end of rounds.
[*]Added kamikazes to Metroplex II.
[*]Added labels to the arrow displays for switching between shops and tab screens.
[*]Increased Space Jam's base health from 2,000 to 2,250.[/list]
[b]BUG FIXES[/b][list]
[*]Fixed a bug causing the bonus damage indicator to sometimes appear when it shouldn't.
[*]Shields now properly have collision with missiles.
[*]The Beacon's shield now has collision with bullets and missiles.[/list]
Thank you everyone! We'll see you out there in the Exoverse!

Hey folks!

It's time for a BIG update! This update has it all - significant visual improvements, gameplay enhancements, bug fixes, optimizations... and more! Here's the full rundown of the changes:

[b]NEW & IMPROVED[/b][list]
[*]Completely remodeled the Metroplex! This includes a visible skybox. Enjoy!
[*]Added a brand new title screen! This one is entirely 2D, and changes based on progression.
[*]The pistol has been completely reaniamted! It now has proper reload and sprint animations, and the arms now change properly when playing as Vance.
[*]Added a new bonus damage display! When dealing bonus damage to enemies, the number now has a special display.
[*]Normal damage numbers now grow rapidly to their normal size when spawned.
[*]Started hooking up Fabian's animations. More to come, but he's no longer in a t-pose!
[*]Relics are no longer removed from your inventory at the end of an unsuccessful run, or by quitting to the title screen.
[*]The radar now displays items on the map - in addition to enemies.
[*]Your crosshair is now enlarged if terrain is within range of your shot.
[*]Mousing over a grayed out menu item now displays a little arrow leading to the info box text.
[*]Shadow blurbs for items that bob and rotate now vary in intensity depending on the height of the bob.
[*]Added some animation to the tab screen.
[*]The camera now transitions more smoothly when switching between weapons.
[*]Your weapons are now reloaded automatically when entering a planning phase.
[*]Lowered Space Jam's start health from 2,500 to 2,000.

[*]Added a kick animation to the cymaran commando.[/list]

[*]Lowered the cost of the Rune of Aries from $5,000 to $2,000.
[*]Lowered the cost of the Rune of Taurus from $10,000 to $5,000.[/list]

[*]Made a fix to pathing to more consistently give a valid starting point.
[*]Enabling vertical sync will no longer cap your framerate to lower than desired levels under certain conditions.
[*]Fixed an issue with tower range indicators blocking particles from rendering.
[*]The commando now turns to face you more often during his ranged attack.
[*]Fixed the bounding box on the portal in the Nebula Omnis. It was set incorrectly and would disappear as you approached it.
[*]Fixed a bug causing Space Jam to destroy other pieces when exploding on the Beacon.[/list]

[*]Decal rendering has been greatly optimized. Far more decals can now be present with far less of an impact on your frame rate.
[*]The decals menu option now gives you more choices for how many decals can be present at a given time, rather than just being on/off.
[*]Completed some optimizations to the shadowing system. It should run much better now.
[*]Removed the shadow blurring option as it's no longer needed.
[*]Made an optimization to enemy path following.[/list]
Thank you everyone! We'll see you out there in the Exoverse!

notes.content:

Hey folks!

We're back with another big Exoverse update! This update adds some big visual features, some significant optimizations, and a whole bunch more. Starting with this update, and wrapping up in the next update, we hope the game will be visually up to our lofty standards!

Here's the full rundown on what's new:

[b]NEW & ADDED[/b]
[list][*]Added decals! These include blood splats, scorch marks, bullet holes, etc. on level surfaces. Optimizations forthcoming!

[*]Added pulse turrets! These attack all enemies in the surrounding area. Sounds and effects coming soon![/list]

[*]Changed the turret display in the hub.
[*]Changed the final wave "Hold them off!!" display to instead say "Hold the line!!".
[*]Replaced "clip" with "magazine" terminology in certain weapon descriptions.[/list]Thanks everybody! We'll see you out there in the Exoverse!

[*]Game over/end of area sounds now respect the user's volume settings.
[*]Chips are now properly omitted. Previously, they were only omitted if you had power shots unlocked.

tags.feature: [*]Added sound effects for the XP bar - both when it ticks, and reaches a new level.
[*]Added a new XP level section to the unlocks menu so you can revisit your progress and what the unlocks actually did.
[*]Added some new and tweaked animations for the cymaran phaseeker.
[*]Added giblets for the tubaki hunter.
[*]The left mouse button can now be used to advance dialogs and other displays.
[*]Made some slight UI tweaks to the health bars.
[*]Added new explanation displays for the first time you enter each shop.
[*]Added some visual polish to the Blazar, Revolver, and Bravestar.

tags.balance_change: [*]Swapped Fabian and Vance's unlock position so that Vance (who is complete) unlocks first.
[*]Increased the drop rate of relics by 50%.
[*]A weapon now always appears in the item shop at shop level 1 and 2.
[*]The gambling shop now unlocks before the unlock shops.
[*]Tower bases can now be played on the exterior tiles of the item node.
[*]Increased the Rune of Perseus's champion weapon increase chance from 100% to 250%.
[*]Reduced the chance of the gambling shop not giving you an item by 25%.
[*]Removed the secret room from Metroplex II.
[*]Giggordo can now appear as the boss in world 1.
